items.name: cn
items.title: cn
items.description: Joins class names and resolves Tailwind conflicts, with the Cadence density scale registered.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message that stands out from the page. A status carries its fill, border, icon and word, never colour alone.
items.docs: An Alert is announced when it appears. For a message that is on the page from the start, set role. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short label or count. A status variant carries its fill, text and border tokens.
items.docs: A status badge's text must say what the status is. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action. Sized by the density set on the page.
items.docs: Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Groups related content on its own surface, with a header, content and footer.
items.docs: Give CardTitle a heading level with render={<h2 />}. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A choice that is on, off or partly on. Its target is as large as a control.
items.docs: Wrap each Checkbox in a Label. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A window over the page for one task. It holds focus, is never taller than the screen, and its scrim darkens the page in both modes.
items.docs: Give every Dialog a DialogTitle: it is the dialog's name. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: One control with its label, description and error, tied together so none of it is wired by hand.
items.docs: Put one control in each Field. Render FieldError only while the value is wrong. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text input. Sized by the density set on the page.
items.docs: Give every Input a Label or an aria-label. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row of media, a title and a description, and actions. Its text wraps and is never cut short.
items.docs: For a list, render ItemGroup as a ul and each Item as an li. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Names a control. Its text follows the density set on the page.
items.docs: Point htmlFor at the control's id. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: One choice from a few, all visible at once.
items.docs: Name the group, and wrap each item in a Label. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: One choice from a list that opens below the field. A long value wraps and is never truncated.
items.docs: Pass items to Select so the field shows an option's label, and give SelectTrigger a Label or an aria-label. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A rule between two groups of content, announced as a separator.
items.docs: Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Shows that something is in progress. It fades instead of turning under reduced motion.
items.docs: Pass aria-hidden when text beside it already says what is happening. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Turns a setting on or off, and the change applies at once.
items.docs: Wrap the Switch in a Label. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Views of one subject, one shown at a time. Tabs that do not fit wrap, and none is clipped.
items.docs: Give each TabsTrigger and its TabsContent the same value. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text input that grows with what is typed.
items.docs: Give every Textarea a Label or an aria-label, or put it in a Field. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed. Pressed is a fill and a boundary, never colour alone.
items.docs: With iconOnly, keep the label as the toggle's text. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint shown when its trigger is hovered or focused. Never the only place something is said.
items.docs: A tooltip does not open on a touch screen and is not announced by a screen reader, so its trigger needs its own name. Cadence grades the component it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.

items.name: typeset
items.title: Typeset
items.description: Styles plain HTML inside a typeset container: rendered markdown, patient information and clinical notes.
items.docs: Wrap content in an element with the typeset class. Cadence grades the stylesheet it publishes. A copy you have edited carries no Cadence grade: see https://www.cadenceclinical.dev/docs/grades.
